newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said early-maturing contracts were more active than late-maturing ones today due to expectations that the rates were likely to fall in the short term.

"Few investors were willing to build longer-term positions because the market widely expects the rates to go down in the short term with the central bank likely to cut bank reserve ratios before the end of this year," one trader said.
Traders said state banks continued to lend out money on the market today, indicating sufficient short-term money supply at the national level.
